skill.name: seo-fundamentals
skill.description: Explains SEO fundamentals, including E-E-A-T, Core Web Vitals, technical foundations, content quality, structured data, and search evaluation principles.
skill.summary: Learn practical SEO fundamentals and check basic page-level SEO issues.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns across the two scanned files. Manual review found educational SEO guidance and a local page checker with no prompt injection, network access, credential access, or command execution intent. No security remediation is required.

content.value_statement: SEO work can become confusing when rankings, quality, and technical signals are treated as shortcuts. This skill explains durable SEO principles and provides a basic checker for page-level issues.
actual_capabilities: Explains E-E-A-T as a quality evaluation framework.
Summarizes Core Web Vitals targets for loading, interaction, and layout stability.
Describes crawl control, indexing signals, canonical tags, HTTPS, and semantic HTML.
Maps page titles, meta descriptions, headings, alt text, and content depth to SEO principles.
Lists common structured data types and explains their role in search understanding.
Includes a local checker for HTML, JSX, and TSX page files.
limitations: Does not perform live keyword research or competitor analysis.
Does not query search engines, analytics platforms, or webmaster tools.
The included checker is limited to basic page files and the first 50 matches.
Does not guarantee rankings, rich results, or search traffic gains.

use_cases.title: Audit Content Basics
use_cases.description: Review whether a page has clear intent, useful content, strong headings, and accessible image context.

use_cases.title: Check Web Page Signals
use_cases.description: Scan page files for missing titles, descriptions, Open Graph tags, H1 issues, and image alt problems.

use_cases.title: Learn SEO Concepts
use_cases.description: Understand how E-E-A-T, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and technical access support search visibility.

prompt_templates.title: Explain SEO Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seo-fundamentals skill to explain E-E-A-T, Core Web Vitals, and technical SEO in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seo-fundamentals skill to review this page outline for title clarity, heading structure, intent match, and content quality.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Technical Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seo-fundamentals skill to create a technical SEO checklist for a React site before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Compare SEO Priorities
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seo-fundamentals skill to rank SEO issues by likely impact across content quality, crawl access, structured data, and page experience.

output_examples.input: Review a product page outline for SEO fundamentals.
output_examples.output: The review highlights unclear search intent, a weak title, missing trust signals, and no structured product details.

output_examples.input: Explain why a fast page may still perform poorly in search.
output_examples.output: The answer explains that speed helps user experience, but relevance, usefulness, accuracy, and trust usually carry more weight.

output_examples.input: Summarize basic issues found by the local checker.
output_examples.output: The summary reports missing descriptions, missing Open Graph tags, multiple H1 elements, and images without useful alt text.

best_practices: Start with user intent and content usefulness before technical tuning.
Use clear page titles, logical headings, and accurate descriptions.
Validate SEO quality with search visibility, engagement, performance, and indexing data.
anti_patterns: Treating E-E-A-T as a direct ranking score.
Publishing unreviewed AI content without original value or fact checks.
Adding structured data that does not match visible page content.

faq.question: Does this skill optimize pages automatically?
faq.answer: No. It explains SEO principles and can guide reviews, but it does not rewrite or deploy pages by itself.

faq.question: Can it check a local web project?
faq.answer: Yes. The included checker can scan likely page files for basic metadata, heading, and image-alt issues.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it provide live search ranking data?
faq.answer: No. It does not connect to search engines, analytics tools, or ranking databases.

faq.question: Is structured data treated as a ranking boost?
faq.answer: No. The skill explains that structured data helps search engines understand content and may support rich result eligibility.

faq.question: What should users review after using it?
faq.answer: Users should verify facts, match advice to current search documentation, and test changes with real performance data.
